sources.title: eVisa South Sudan: Apply for Visa to South Sudan online
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, South Sudan National Police, Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Government eServices portal identifies the competent Interior/immigration directorate and sets out the PDF-before-travel workflow, but exposes no nationality eligibility schedule or individual public result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours.

sources.title: South Sudan Trade Information Hub: Immigration services
sources.publisher: South Sudan Trade Information Hub, Ministry of Trade and Industry
sources.officialityEvidence: Live verified-TLS Government Trade Information Hub describes immigration services and links the Ministry of Interior eVisa. It identifies concurrent electronic, arrival and pre-approved pathways but gives no nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Most travelers can obtain visa on arrival; however, some nationalities may require a pre-approved visa.

sources.title: EAC Partner States
sources.officialityEvidence: Live EAC Secretariat page identifies the current eight Partner States, expressly including Somalia and South Sudan, and therefore supplies the nationality scope for its current visa-free-entry guidance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The EAC comprises eight (8) Partner States: ... Federal Republic of Somalia ... Republic of South Sudan.

sources.title: Visa-Free Entry
sources.officialityEvidence: Live EAC Secretariat immigration guidance says all Partner States implement Protocol Article 7(1) for visa-free entry of Partner-State citizens into other Partner States; it is direct regional current-force guidance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Partner States are implementing Article 7(1) ... visa-free entry of citizens of EAC Partner States.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Travelling in East Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: Live EAC Secretariat FAQ is marked written 14 April 2016 but remains currently published. It expressly preserves a DRC exception, creating an unresolved conflict with the general current page for CD.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of East African Community Partner States (with the exception of DRC) do not require visas.

unresolved.reason: Current EAC-wide guidance names Somalia and South Sudan as Partner States and describes visa-free movement for Partner-State citizens, but the last reproducible South Sudan Foreign Ministry nationality table exempted only Egypt, Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. The regional prose does not independently resolve South Sudan's ordinary Somali-passport implementation, while the current Interior eVisa portal publishes no nationality result. No route is selected from the conflict.

The current Interior eVisa portal proves a downloadable PDF for approved applicants, but asks whether the traveller is eligible and publishes no ordinary-passport nationality result. The accessible government Trade Hub describes both eVisa and arrival/pre-approved paths without a nationality schedule. No passport-wide eVisa entitlement is established.
